title: Яд

words.ex: This girl did not poison my wine.
words.ex_ru: Эта девушка не отравляла моё вино.

words.ex: Find the real poisoner in three days and prove it.
words.ex_ru: Найди настоящего отравителя за три дня и докажи это.

words.ex: If you cannot, she is guilty, and she dies.
words.ex_ru: Если не сможешь — она виновна, и она умрёт.

story: Where the wine touched the floor, the stone began to smoke. Someone screamed.
Corin stood up from his throne. “The mortal knew,” he said, and his voice filled the hall. “How did she know, unless she brought it herself? I blame the girl. Guards, take her.”
Two guards grabbed Mira's arms. “Kneel before the prince,” one of them ordered, and pushed her down.
“I saw a servant,” Mira said. “He put something in the cup. Look for him!”
But the servant had vanished. Nobody remembered his face. Everybody had worn a mask.
“She is lying,” Corin said. “Mortals lie all the time. It is the only thing they do well.”
Ash stepped between Mira and the throne. “Then let me speak. You all know I cannot lie. So hear the truth: this girl did not poison my wine. She saved my life.”
The hall was silent. A fae cannot lie — everyone knew that. Corin's smile disappeared.
“Words are not proof, brother,” he said at last. “But I will show mercy tonight. Find the real poisoner in three days and prove it. If you cannot, she is guilty, and she dies.”
Later, alone in her room, Mira could not stop shaking. Who did she suspect? The servant, of course. But who sent him?
There was a soft knock at the door. Lirra came in, pale and nervous.
“I know a secret,” she whispered. “But not here. Meet me in the forest at midnight.”

questions.q: What happened when the wine touched the floor?
Why did everyone believe Ash's words?
How many days does Ash have to find the poisoner?

grammar.title: «Уже было»: had + 3-я форма (Past Perfect)
grammar.text:
Когда в рассказе о прошлом говорят о том, что случилось ещё раньше, используют had + третья форма глагола.

But the servant had vanished — «Но слуга (к тому моменту уже) исчез».
Everybody had worn a mask — «Все (тогда) были в масках».
anything she had ever worn — «всё, что она когда-либо носила».

Третья форма у обычных глаголов — с -ed (vanish → vanished), у неправильных — своя: wear → wore → worn, see → saw → seen, go → went → gone.
